description: Read back the prior-period snapshot and populate CostSummaryDto.previousClusterMonthlyCost so the shipped Overview hero Trend chip lights up, plus the full test suite for the whole task. Keep WorkloadCostAttributionService.summary(...) pure (it has no cluster context); add a CostSummaryDto.withPreviousClusterMonthlyCost(Double) wither and apply it in VerticalAutomationReadService.evaluate(...) using target.clusterConfigId(). When no prior snapshot exists, pass null — the hero stays an honest em-dash; NEVER fabricate a prior. Depends on FEAT-001 (repository) and FEAT-002 (so the full daily-write -> daily-read path is exercised end to end).
steps: In xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/automation/workload/api/dto/CostSummaryDto.java add a wither mirroring the existing withRollups: public CostSummaryDto withPreviousClusterMonthlyCost(Double previous) that returns a copy with every field unchanged except previousClusterMonthlyCost = previous. Update the record's javadoc to note the value is now sourced from the persisted cluster_cost_snapshot prior period (still null when there is no prior).

In xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/automation/workload/api/VerticalAutomationReadService.java: constructor-inject ClusterCostSnapshotRepository, ClusterCostSnapshotProperties, and a java.time.Clock (if the class does not already hold a Clock; reuse its existing clock field if present). In evaluate(...), immediately after `costSummary = costAttributionService.summary(...).withRollups(nodeCosts, namespaceCosts);`, compute the prior: cutoff = clock.instant().minus(Duration.ofHours(snapshotProperties.priorLookbackHours())); Optional<ClusterCostSnapshot> prior = repo.findTopByClusterConfigIdAndCapturedAtLessThanEqualOrderByCapturedAtDesc(target.clusterConfigId(), cutoff); then costSummary = costSummary.withPreviousClusterMonthlyCost(prior.map(ClusterCostSnapshot::getClusterMonthlyCost).orElse(null)). Only do this when costEnabled (inside the existing `if (costEnabled)` block) so an off cluster keeps null. Do NOT change WorkloadCostAttributionService.summary(...) — it stays pure and keeps passing null.

Create xamops-service/src/test/java/com/xammer/cloud/repository/ClusterCostSnapshotRepositoryTest.java as an H2 slice test copying WorkloadVerticalActionRepositoryTest's harness exactly (@DataJpaTest, @ContextConfiguration(classes = JpaSliceTestConfig.class), @TestPropertySource(properties = {"spring.autoconfigure.exclude=", "spring.flyway.enabled=false"})). Cover: (a) save/read round-trip (id + fields persist, capturedAt @PrePersist stamp when null); (b) read-back selects the newest snapshot at/before a cutoff (insert snapshots at e.g. -48h, -24h, -1h; cutoff = now-24h returns the -24h row, not -1h); (c) null-when-no-history (no rows, or only a row newer than the cutoff, returns Optional.empty()).

Create xamops-service/src/test/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/automation/workload/cost/ClusterCostSnapshotServiceTest.java as a pure unit test with Mockito mocks for VerticalAutomationReadService, KubernetesClusterConfigRepository, CloudAccountRepository, ClusterCostSnapshotRepository, and a fixed Clock. Cover: (a) skip-when-switch-off (snapshotProperties.enabled()==false => readService never called, repository.save never called); (b) skip-when-cost-feature-off (K8sCostProperties disabled => no save); (c) write-when-cost-real (read returns a VerticalEngineResponse whose cost().clusterMonthlyCost() is a real number => exactly one save with that value and the fixed-clock instant); (d) skip-when-cost-null (read.cost()==null or clusterMonthlyCost()==null => no save); (e) one cluster throwing does not stop the others (two configs, first read throws, second still gets snapshotted).

Add/extend a read-back test proving summary() surfaces a real prior: either extend the cost read-service test package or add a focused test that, given a stored prior snapshot for a clusterConfigId within the lookback window, VerticalAutomationReadService produces a CostSummaryDto with previousClusterMonthlyCost equal to the stored value, and given no prior snapshot it is null. If a VerticalAutomationReadService unit test harness already exists, extend it; otherwise assert the wiring at the CostSummaryDto.withPreviousClusterMonthlyCost level plus the repository query behavior already covered in step 3.
Confirm the new tests pass in isolation and are NOT masked by the known-unrelated AwsPermissionCatalogKubernetesTest failure (do not fix that test).
acceptance_criteria: CostSummaryDto has withPreviousClusterMonthlyCost(Double) that copies all other fields unchanged; summary(...) remains pure and still passes null.

VerticalAutomationReadService.evaluate(...) populates previousClusterMonthlyCost from the prior snapshot (newest at/before now - priorLookbackHours) for the cluster, and leaves it null when no prior snapshot exists.
ClusterCostSnapshotRepositoryTest proves write/read-back, correct prior-window selection, and null-when-no-history on H2.
ClusterCostSnapshotServiceTest proves skip-when-off, write-when-cost-real, skip-when-cost-null, and per-cluster failure isolation.
A test proves summary()/read produces a real previousClusterMonthlyCost when a snapshot exists and null when it does not.

`cd xamops-service && mvn -o -pl . test -Dtest='ClusterCostSnapshotRepositoryTest,ClusterCostSnapshotServiceTest'` passes, and the broader `mvn -o -pl . -am test` shows no NEW failures beyond the pre-existing AwsPermissionCatalogKubernetesTest one.
verification: cd /Users/apple/Desktop/XamOps-New/.worktrees/cloudk8s-cost-snapshot/xamops-service && mvn -o -pl . -am test  # expect only the known-unrelated AwsPermissionCatalogKubernetesTest.logsDegradesKubernetes_andKeepsItsOtherFeatures to fail, nothing cost/snapshot-related
findings: DTO: CostSummaryDto.withPreviousClusterMonthlyCost(Double previous) added, mirroring withRollups — copies every field unchanged except previousClusterMonthlyCost=previous; javadoc updated to say the value is now sourced from the persisted cluster_cost_snapshot prior period (still null when none, never fabricated). summary(...) in WorkloadCostAttributionService stays PURE and still passes null (untouched). Read path: VerticalAutomationReadService now constructor-injects ClusterCostSnapshotRepository snapshotRepository + ClusterCostSnapshotProperties snapshotProperties (added to BOTH the @Autowired production constructor — now 16 args — AND the package-private test-seam constructor; it already held a Clock field, reused). In evaluate(...), inside the existing if(costEnabled) block, immediately after `costSummary = ...summary(...).withRollups(nodeCosts, namespaceCosts);`: Instant cutoff = clock.instant().minus(Duration.ofHours(snapshotProperties.priorLookbackHours())); Optional<ClusterCostSnapshot> prior = snapshotRepository.findTopByClusterConfigIdAndCapturedAtLessThanEqualOrderByCapturedAtDesc(target.clusterConfigId(), cutoff); costSummary = costSummary.withPreviousClusterMonthlyCost(prior.map(ClusterCostSnapshot::getClusterMonthlyCost).orElse(null)). Cost-off clusters keep null (block not entered). Tests added: (1) src/test/java/com/xammer/cloud/repository/ClusterCostSnapshotRepositoryTest.java — H2 @DataJpaTest + JpaSliceTestConfig, 6 tests: round-trip, @PrePersist stamp when null, newest-at/before-cutoff selection (-48h/-24h/-1h with cutoff=-24h returns the -24h row not -1h), per-cluster scoping, null-when-no-history, null-when-only-row-newer-than-cutoff. (2) src/test/java/.../cost/ClusterCostSnapshotServiceTest.java — pure Mockito unit, 6 tests: snapshot-switch-off (verifyNoInteractions), cost-feature-off (verifyNoInteractions), real-cost write-once with value+fixed-clock instant, null cost() no-save, null clusterMonthlyCost() no-save, per-cluster failure isolation (first read throws, second still snapshotted). (3) Read-back proof extended into the existing VerticalAutomationReadServiceTest harness (3 new tests): stored prior => previousClusterMonthlyCost==512.0; no prior => null; query asserts cluster-config-id scoping + cutoff = CYCLE_AT - 24h. Harness plumbing: VerticalReadServiceFixtures gained snapshotDefaults(), noPriorSnapshots(), priorSnapshot(double) and a costService(...) overload taking a ClusterCostSnapshotRepository; both fixture constructor call sites, the inline constructor in VerticalAutomationReadServiceTest, and VerticalAutomationReadServiceContextTest (ApplicationContextRunner beans + the direct constructor in costNullWhenOff) updated for the 2 new ctor args. Verification: targeted `mvn -o -pl . test -Dtest='ClusterCostSnapshotRepositoryTest,ClusterCostSnapshotServiceTest'` green; the combined run of the 2 targeted + VerticalAutomationReadServiceTest(41) + VerticalAutomationReadServiceContextTest(2) = 55 tests all pass. Full `mvn -o -pl . -am test`: 3738 run, 1 failure, 0 errors — the ONLY failure is the pre-existing known-unrelated AwsPermissionCatalogKubernetesTest.logsDegradesKubernetes_andKeepsItsOtherFeatures (not touched); no cost/snapshot-related failures.
